activity.output_text:
BIGJOE BUSINESS IDEA ANALYSIS

Your request: Give me 5 business ideas i can start with 100000

1. Recommended direction
Choose a business that matches your available capital, location, skills and customer demand.

2. Potential ideas
• Retail/reselling — start with fast-moving products and reinvest profits.
• Food/snacks — focus on a small menu with repeat local demand.
• Digital services — graphics, document services, social-media support or AI-assisted services.
• Distribution — buy selected fast-moving products in bulk and supply smaller retailers.

3. How to choose
Compare each idea by startup cost, expected margin, competition, repeat customers and cash-flow speed.

4. First 30 days
Validate demand with real customers, start small, record every sale and expense in BIGJOE, then reinvest into the products/services with the strongest margins.

If you give me your exact capital, location and skills, I can turn this into a more specific business plan.
